description: Relates 2-8 world places and up to 8 named entities, deterministically. For each place: its ROAST-78 tile card and element. For every pair: elemental dignity (Golden Dawn rules: strengthening, friendly, opposing or neutral), same suit, lattice step, great-circle distance and initial bearing, and the card of the midpoint tile. Each name is turned into a card sequence with the Anagramic alphabet cipher (A-V = Major Arcana, W-Z = the four Aces), with its dominant element and its dignity with each place. For games, matchmaking, travel stories and multi-location worldbuilding. Includes a receipt hash. Price: $0.02 USDC per call after 25 free calls per day.

_payment.description: x402 v2 payment: base64 PaymentPayload, as you would send in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Only needed after the free allowance is used.

entities.description: Optional. Up to 8 names (people, characters, places, brands), max 64 characters each. GET: comma-separated.
